review_notes:
I reviewed all 51 lines and found nothing that duplicates an existing Mathlib concept. The file contains three declarations:
- `multipointConstant` (lines 15–17): a constant specific to this project, built from `(3 : ℝ)^m` and `Real.exp` of the project's own `Multipoint.uniformDiscountBudget κ (Multipoint.sourceBeta κ) Finset.univ`. Mathlib, core and Batteries have no general concept that this re-implements. I grepped the OAI tree and found no second, independent definition of the same constant. Every other match is a use of this one name, in files such as `WeightedLevelMoments`, `CompactLevelMoments`, `DiskIntegratedMoments` and `PhysicalCenteredWeights`. Those uses show that naming the constant does useful work: callers can refer to the constant by name instead of unfolding the full expression.
- `multipointConstant_pos` (lines 19–21): a positivity lemma about that constant, not a new concept.
- `RegularSLEPresentation.physical_multipoint_main` (lines 26–46): a theorem that wraps the project's `Multipoint.capped_physical_radius_multipoint_bound`. It uses standard Mathlib notions throughout (`Measure.comap`, `ENNReal.ofReal`, `DifferentiableOn`, `InjOn`, `Function.Injective`, `dist`) and defines no rival version of any of them. Theorem duplication is outside this rubric anyway.
The SLE-specific objects the file depends on (`RegularSLEPresentation`, `survivingDomain`, `physicalConformalRadius`, `PublishedDiskUnivalentGrowth`, `upperHalfPlane`) are defined in other files, so I did not judge them here. I did not have to rely on any unverified assumption to reach this conclusion.
